rent-paid-this-month.title: This month's rent paid while I catch up
rent-paid-this-month.line: I found local rental assistance through 211, and this month's rent is covered while I get back on my feet.
rent-paid-this-month.writerNotes: Obvious basic: emergency rent help exists in most places, though funds run out. Tonight-level because the call can happen now.

rent-at-a-third-of-income.title: Paying about a third of my income on rent
rent-at-a-third-of-income.line: My rent is set at about 30% of what I earn, so the rest of my paycheck goes to food, bills, and savings.
rent-at-a-third-of-income.writerNotes: Vouchers and public housing already work this way; waiting lists are long, so this-year rather than tonight.

lower-rent-at-renewal.title: A lower rent at my next lease renewal
lower-rent-at-renewal.line: When my lease came up, I showed my landlord similar listings and my record of paying on time, and we settled on less than they first asked.
lower-rent-at-renewal.writerNotes: About one in four renters who tried succeeded in 2023; makes an ordinary step feel worth trying.

rent-increases-capped.title: Yearly rent increases capped by law
rent-increases-capped.line: My rent can only go up by a set amount each year, so I never open a renewal letter to a jump I can't pay.
rent-increases-capped.writerNotes: Named plainly as rent control/stabilization; contested (Stanford study shows supply effects), so fixes should present it as a proposal with more than one direction.

overpaid-rent-returned.title: Getting back rent I was overcharged
overpaid-rent-returned.line: I checked my apartment's legal rent and rent history, and my landlord had to lower my rent and pay back part of what I'd overpaid.
overpaid-rent-returned.writerNotes: Conny and JustFix both make rent-history and overcharge checks easy; outcome depends on local law.

knowing-fair-rent-before-signing.title: Knowing what my rent should be before I sign
knowing-fair-rent-before-signing.line: Before I sign a lease, I can see what similar apartments nearby rent for and who owns the building, so I know whether the price is fair.
knowing-fair-rent-before-signing.writerNotes: Germany's rent index and Who Owns What show the data can exist; a likely place for an It feature.

splitting-rent-with-a-chosen-housemate.title: Splitting rent with a housemate I chose
splitting-rent-with-a-chosen-housemate.line: I share a home with someone I met and picked, and we each pay a fraction of what living alone cost me.
splitting-rent-with-a-chosen-housemate.writerNotes: Home-sharing services screen and match; AARP shows wide willingness among older women to live with a friend.

less-rent-for-help-around-the-house.title: Paying less rent in exchange for help around the house
less-rent-for-help-around-the-house.line: I rent a spare room from an older homeowner and pay less because I help with groceries, chores, and yard work.
less-rent-for-help-around-the-house.writerNotes: Nesterly lets guests trade help for lower rent; HomeShare Vermont matches older hosts with younger guests.

saving-while-living-with-family.title: Saving money while I live with family for a while
saving-while-living-with-family.line: I moved back in with my parents for now, and the money I'd have spent on rent is going into savings for a place of my own.
saving-while-living-with-family.writerNotes: Common and obvious; Pew shows finances are the main reason for younger adults. Not possible or safe for everyone.

a-house-for-the-cost-of-a-room.title: A whole house for what one room cost
a-house-for-the-cost-of-a-room.line: I moved to a cheaper city with my remote job, and my payment on a three-bedroom house is about what I paid for one room before.
a-house-for-the-cost-of-a-room.writerNotes: Tulsa Remote participant quote supports this; only for people with remote jobs, and moving away has real costs.

tenants-holding-rents-steady-together.title: My building's tenants keeping our rent steady together
tenants-holding-rents-steady-together.line: My neighbors and I formed a tenants union, and now our rent holds steady and repairs get done by a set deadline.
tenants-holding-rents-steady-together.writerNotes: KC Tenants won a contract freezing rent and setting repair deadlines after an eight-month rent strike; risky, best with numbers and legal backing.

owning-through-a-land-trust.title: Owning an affordable home through a land trust
owning-through-a-land-trust.line: I bought a home through a community land trust at a price I could afford, and when I sell I keep part of the gain.
owning-through-a-land-trust.writerNotes: Champlain Housing Trust sellers left about $14,000 richer and most bought again; builds less wealth than market homes.

city-owned-apartments-for-working-people.title: Good city-owned apartments for people with ordinary incomes
city-owned-apartments-for-working-people.line: My city builds and owns well-kept apartments where people like me pay rent we can afford, the way Vienna has for about a century.
city-owned-apartments-for-working-people.writerNotes: Social housing named plainly; Montgomery County shows a U.S. version is starting. Contested and slow.

more-homes-so-rents-stop-climbing.title: Enough new homes nearby that rents stop climbing
more-homes-so-rents-stop-climbing.line: My city allowed more apartments and duplexes to be built, and rents near me rose much less than in the rest of the state.
more-homes-so-rents-stop-climbing.writerNotes: Minneapolis supply reforms are the strongest evidence; LA backyard homes show another way to add supply. Contested in some neighborhoods.

sharing-a-home-with-friends-as-we-age.title: Sharing a house with friends as we get older
sharing-a-home-with-friends-as-we-age.line: A few friends and I share one house as we age, and splitting the costs means none of us is stretched thin.
sharing-a-home-with-friends-as-we-age.writerNotes: Culture lens: AARP shows 57% of women 50+ would consider it, and Colorado removed local caps on unrelated housemates. Willingness, not practice yet.

overlaps.reason: Both are home-sharing, and trading help for lower rent is one form of sharing with a chosen housemate.
Sharing a house with friends is a version of splitting rent with a chosen housemate.
Both end with rent that holds steady; one gets there by law and one by tenants negotiating together.
Both rest on knowing a home's legal or comparable rent, before and after signing.
Both are rent paid partly by an assistance program; one is short-term help, the other a lasting subsidy.
